arc: Forwarder for RA,RS,NA,NS between physical & ARC interfaces This is the implementation of a proper NDProxy that forward ICMPv6 RA, RS, NA. and NS packets between physical and ARC interfaces accoring to RFC 4389. Note that in this CL the NDProxy implementation is not integrated with arc-networkd yet - that means only merging this CL will have no affect on current ARC network behavior. Another CL will be submitted later to glue arc-networkd to this implementation and remove the current IPv6 provisioning workaround. The architecure (especially thread model) of this class may also change to adapt. BUG=b:138410292, b:138410370 TEST=unit test for packet operations; manual: this class is not connected with arc-networkd yet. Tested manually by creating a stand-alone daemon with it and verifying IPv6 provisioned correctly in ARCVM. vm_tools: sommelier: A better fix for scaling The previous fix for scaling tried to undo some of the calculations made on the display, but only in the special case of the internal display, it had two drawbacks: - Two wrongs dont make a right - It didnt work for external displays with nonstandard DPI. This is a better fix which solves both problems by scrapping the physical size calculation and instead working backwards from the DPI we want to end up with (which comes from the ideal scale and the conventional DPI). UPSTREAM: ath6kl: add some bounds checking The "ev->traffic_class" and "reply->ac" variables come from the network and they're used as an offset into the wmi->stream_exist_for_ac[] array. Those variables are u8 so they can be 0-255 but the stream_exist_for_ac[] array only has WMM_NUM_AC (4) elements. We need to add a couple bounds checks to prevent array overflows. I also modified one existing check from "if (traffic_class > 3) {" to "if (traffic_class >= WMM_NUM_AC) {" just to make them all consistent. In particular, MOCK_METHOD() supports annotating a mocked method with specifiers such as 'override'. One minor change is that argument names are omitted in the argument list provided to MOCK_METHOD() in order to prevent clang-format from formatting code like `Foo* foo` into `Foo * foo`.
